summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Quick Wing Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform. All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all key features working: Super Admin login redirects to /platform, Tenants tab with CRUD operations, Reports & Billing with PDF export, tenant-specific branded login URLs, and Master Admin Setup Wizard.

Backend: Super Admin invalid password rejected (401)
Backend: Master Admin login success with tenant memberships
Backend: /api/platform/tenants requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: Platform tenants list returns correct structure
Backend: Platform stats endpoint returns tenant/user/vehicle/booking counts
Backend: Platform audit log accessible
Backend: Tenant lookup by slug (kerry-fleet) works
Backend: Non-existent tenant slug returns 404
Backend: Executive Summary report endpoint works
Backend: Executive Summary PDF export returns valid PDF
Backend: Franchises report endpoint works
Backend: Franchises report PDF export works
Backend: Invoices list endpoint works
Backend: Tenant creation with auto-generated Master Admin credentials
Backend: /api/auth/me returns correct Super Admin info
Backend: /api/auth/me returns correct Master Admin info with memberships
Frontend: Super Admin login at /login redirects to /platform
Frontend: Franchise Command Centre header displayed
Frontend: All tabs visible (Overview, Tenants, Users, Reports & Billing, Audit Log)

Key endpoints: POST /api/auth/login (returns user.role), GET /api/platform/tenants (requires auth), GET /api/platform/reports/executive-summary/pdf (PDF export). Tenant slugs: kerry-fleet, lee.
